args.title: Juniper Labware: Retail returns logistics — summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Juniper Labware newsletter, its linked article, and the companion piece:

- The latest Juniper Labware newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to a blog article and a companion piece (accessible via Northwind team licence).
- Article: apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (20%).
- Companion piece: reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
